The '''mother''' of [[Kajin Savaros]] was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] on [[M'haeli/Legends|M'haeli]]. When an [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] visited their world, she and her husband [[Bey Savaros|Bey]] decided to send their son to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], hoping someone from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] would take him in and train him.<ref name="POF">''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''</ref>
